Message.Name: Latency Stat Message
Message.Description: A Latency Stat Message demonstrates performance for a specific Matching Engine unit for a specific timeframe

Field.Name: Matching Unit
Field.Description: Refer to the Multicast PITCH specification for Matching Unit mappings

Field.Name: Begin Time
Field.Description: Number of milliseconds from midnight (London time)

Field.Name: End Time
Field.Description: Number of milliseconds from midnight (London time)

Field.Name: Count
Field.Description: Count of orders used in calculation of all other metrics from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: Minimum
Field.Description: Minimum order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: Maximum
Field.Description: Maximum order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: Average
Field.Description: Average order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: Mode
Field.Description: Mode of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: 99.9 Percentile
Field.Description: 99.9 percentile of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: 99 Percentile
Field.Description: 99 percentile of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: 95 Percentile
Field.Description: 95 percentile of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: 90 Percentile
Field.Description: 90 percentile of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: 75 Percentile
Field.Description: 75 percentile of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: 50 Percentile (Median)
Field.Description: 50 percentile of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time

Field.Name: 25 Percentile
Field.Description: 25 percentile of order processing latency (seconds) from Begin Time to End Time
